name: verify_answer
trigger: The outbound verification listener answers yes, no, or unsure.

fallback.message: I couldn't record that. Please open the Village app now.

condition.prompt: The listener denied asking for money.

steps.message: Thank you. I'm telling her not to send anything, and Ana will see it in the app now.

condition.prompt: The listener confirmed asking for money.

steps.message: Thanks. I'll tell her it was you. Village never sends money, and Ana will see this too.

fallback.message: Okay. I'll tell her not to send anything until you or Ana talk to her.
